trace_links.n: Keep the fleet running: equipment availability at 90 percent
trace_links.story: Find failures before they stop a truck and plan the work so crews are not pulled into breakdowns.
Fewer injuries, every permit verified, and every corrective action closed when promised.

trace_links.n: More tonnes through the plant at a lower cost per tonne
trace_links.story: Lift plant throughput by 9 percent and bring the cost per tonne milled under $22.
Deliver every commitment made to the community on time and have no environmental permit exceedances.

trace_links.n: Condition monitoring on the haul fleet
trace_links.story: Sensors on 40 haul trucks. Installation is behind on 12 trucks, so the services line is forecast over budget.
Twelve trucks need a second sensor mount.
A weekly schedule frozen two days ahead, with parts kitted before the crew arrives.
Permits and isolations recorded on rugged tablets, checked before release.
New liners and pumps on the second ball mill. Liner delivery is late and the equipment line is forecast 11 percent over.

trace_links.n: Second ball mill liners and pumps
trace_links.story: Expedited freight for the late liners.
Separate the plant control network from the office network, one zone at a time.
One register of every promise made to the community, each with an owner and a date.
Second sensor shipment, received and counted at the warehouse.
Bills installation on all 40 trucks; sensors on 12 trucks are not commissioned yet.
Liner delivery is two weeks late; the contract allows a 5 percent holdback for late delivery.
Slurry pumps delivered and inspected.
Annual subscription, as ordered.
Two firewalls arrived with the wrong firmware version and cannot be installed.
